summary: This clinical study tests a drug called tirzepatide in adults who have type 1 diabetes and obesity. Type 1 diabetes is a condition where the body does not make enough insulin, and obesity means having a high amount of body fat. Participants will receive either tirzepatide or an inactive substance called a placebo. The Dasman Diabetes Institute is sponsoring this Phase 4 study, which aims to enroll 60 people and is currently Recruiting.
